old_caption: The video captures a fireworks display over a body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing contrast to the vibrant colors of the fireworks. The fireworks burst in various patterns, including prominent green, yellow, and red hues, creating a dynamic spectacle. Each burst illuminates the surrounding area, casting colorful reflections on the water below, which appear mostly static and distorted. In the background, a distinct illuminated skyline of buildings and structures is visible, suggesting an urban setting. The camera exhibits subtle panning movements throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to absorb the beauty and scale of the fireworks show. The overall ambiance is one of celebration and wonder, enhanced by the interplay of light and reflection.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a breathtaking fireworks display over a body of water at night. The sky is dark, providing a stark contrast to the vibrant colors of the fireworks. The fireworks burst in various patterns, predominantly in shades of red, orange, and white, creating a dynamic and festive atmosphere. Each burst illuminates the surrounding area, casting colorful reflections on the water below. The reflections shimmer and dance, mirroring the spectacle above. In the background, faint lights from buildings and structures suggest an urban setting, adding depth to the scene. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the beauty and scale of the fireworks show. The overall ambiance is one of celebration and wonder, enhanced by the interplay of light and reflection.
caption: The video captures a night fireworks display over a calm, dark body of water, with a low strip of city lights and a silhouetted shoreline along the horizon. Large spherical bursts hang in the sky, pinkish-red clusters left of center and a red-and-white sphere on the right, mirrored as elongated smears on the water below. As the excerpt unfolds, the bright spheres dim and scatter into sinking golden-orange sparks. A row of small yellow clusters swells near the lower bursts before fading away. A pale blue-white beam rises from the horizon toward the fireworks, tilting slightly before disappearing. New low red bursts ignite along the skyline, casting fresh pink reflections onto the water. Later, golden-yellow spheres and a greenish-white bloom open at the center of the sky. The reflection patches shift in hue and brightness in step with each burst.
